# SpikeTemporalDataAssociation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for associating object detections across time steps using spike timing and temporal correlations in spiking neural networks, replacing traditional Hungarian or graph-based matching. Shows how temporal spike patterns can encode object identity and motion, critical for realizing fully spike-based tracking pipelines in neuromorphic hardware.
